title: Trump scraps AI security executive order hours before signing
summary: Trump cancelled the signing of an order creating voluntary 90-day pre-release government testing of frontier models after lobbying by Sacks, Musk and Zuckerberg, saying regulation could slow the US lead over China.
reason: Head of state rejects pre-release oversight on explicit race-with-China grounds.

title: Pentagon adds Shield AI autonomy to LUCAS loitering munition
summary: The Pentagon partnered with Shield AI to integrate Hivemind autonomous piloting into the low-cost LUCAS one-way attack drone.
reason: Major military AI contract putting autonomy into a strike weapon.

title: Intuit cuts ~3,000 jobs as it shifts to AI agents
summary: Intuit said it would cut about 8% of staff as it pivots to AI agents, projecting $500M+ annual savings.
reason: Company-cited AI-linked layoffs, mid-size. Exact announcement date unclear (reported week of May 18-22).
